# Aligning Table Captions Left in LaTeX (Without `caption` Package)

Here are several methods:

## Method 1: Using `\captionsetup` from `caption` package
Wait, you said no `caption` package! Let me give you alternatives:

## Method 2: Redefine `\@makecaption`

```latex
\makeatletter
\long\def\@makecaption#1#2{%
  \vskip\abovecaptionskip
  \sbox\@tempboxa{#1: #2}%
  \ifdim \wd\@tempboxa >\hsize
    #1: #2\par
  \else
    \global \@minipagefalse
    \hb@xt@\hsize{\box\@tempboxa\hfil}% Change this line
  \fi
  \vskip\belowcaptionskip}
\makeatother
```

Replace the `\hb@xt@\hsize{\box\@tempboxa\hfil}` line with:
```latex
\hb@xt@\hsize{\box\@tempboxa\hfill}  % For left alignment
```

## Method 3: Simple Redefinition (Easier)

```latex
\makeatletter
\long\def\@makecaption#1#2{%
  \vskip\abovecaptionskip
  \sbox\@tempboxa{#1: #2}%
  #1: #2\par
  \vskip\belowcaptionskip}
\makeatother
```

## Method 4: Using a Minipage

```latex
\begin{table}[h]
\begin{minipage}{\textwidth}
\raggedright
\caption{Your caption here}
\end{minipage}
\centering
\begin{tabular}{cc}
...
\end{tabular}
\end{table}
```

**Method 3** is the simplest and most reliable approach!
